name: mexxi
description: Claude Code mods that make the mexxi workflow easier to watch and harder to trip over. The installer adds this clone as a folder marketplace, so a git pull updates them.

plugins.name: run-pane
plugins.description: A pane beside the chat showing the current /wettaq run, and a band suggesting a fresh session once the PR is delivered or context runs high.

plugins.name: command-fixer
plugins.description: Rewrites Bash calls instead of letting them fail: quotes --include=* globs, adds pipefail to verify pipes, backgrounds a full verify.
